welcome:
I write interactive stories. You decide what happens next.

/new — start a story
/end — finish the current one
/lang — change language
/help — how it works
help:
Send /new and describe the story you want — a genre, a setting, a character, anything. I'll open the scene.

After that, just write what you do. Each message is your next move.

/end closes the current story. /new always starts fresh.
ask_premise:
What should the story be about? Describe a setting, a genre or a character.

Or send /skip and I'll invent something.
story_started: Your story has begun. Write what you do next.
no_active_story: You have no story running. Send /new to start one.
story_ended: Story closed. Send /new whenever you want another.
llm_error: The story engine is not responding. Try again in a moment.
too_long: That message is too long. Keep it under 1000 characters.
busy: I'm still writing the previous part. One moment.
already_active: You already have a story running. Use /end to close it first, or keep playing.
